policy.runtimeDependencyTreatment: Production runtime and dev-tooling findings are both tracked at or above the threshold; reports must label runtime relevance so review can prioritize runtime exposure.
policy.newFindingRule: Any unallowlisted npm audit finding at moderate, high, or critical severity fails the governance command.
policy.allowlistRemovalRule: Entries must name an owner issue, review date, expiry date, and removal condition. Expired or unused entries fail the governance command and must be removed or renewed through a reviewed change.

entries.reason: Residual npm audit owner finding for the bundled Next/PostCSS advisory after the migration series. The audited stable Next 16 line does not yet provide a useful remediation, and npm audit currently suggests the unsupported next@9.3.3 downgrade path.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when the supported Next 15 backport or stable Next line bundles postcss >=8.5.10, or when npm audit no longer reports the Next-owned finding.

entries.reason: Residual bundled PostCSS finding owned by Next after the migration series; direct postcss is already on a fixed version and npm audit currently suggests the unsupported next@9.3.3 downgrade path.
entries.removalCondition: Remove when node_modules/next/node_modules/postcss is no longer below 8.5.10 or the advisory is no longer reported by npm audit.

deprecationResiduals.dependencyPath: eslint -> file-entry-cache -> flat-cache -> rimraf -> glob -> inflight
deprecationResiduals.removalCondition: Remove when the project migrates to an ESLint 9-compatible lint stack and npm ci no longer emits the ESLint 8 transitive deprecation warnings.
Remove when the Tailwind line or its Sucrase transitive dependency no longer installs deprecated glob@10.5.0.
Remove when the graphics dependency line can move to a Drei release that uses three-mesh-bvh >=0.8 without requiring an unplanned React 19/R3F 9 migration.
